choice: Restore documented empty-date/native Rule F diagnostic path; no clock or mtime fallback.
basis: MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md delegates SSSOM validation to scripts/validate_sssom_invariants.py and specifies per-row rejects and failed publication gates. It does not require aborting generation for one dateless record.
Native evaluate_rule_f documents empty mapping_date plus warning and curator reject routing; evaluate_rule_g anchors header to newest dated row.

behavior.mixed_dated_and_dateless: Generate all rows with empty cells unchanged and header from maximum valid calendar date; native Rule F rejects dateless rows.
behavior.all_dateless: No truthful header date exists; report all affected subject IDs and refuse before opening output.
behavior.malformed_nonempty_emitted_dates: Aggregate all malformed values with subject IDs and refuse before opening output.
behavior.history_entries: Only ASCII ISO calendar-valid date prefixes qualify. Warn about invalid entries, ignore them, then select calendar maximum; no valid entries yields empty.
